changes_made: Replaced truthiness check `if(this.jsFunc[methodName])` with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.jsFunc, methodName) && typeof (this.jsFunc as any)[methodName] === 'function'` — eliminates prototype chain traversal
The old check allowed `this.jsFunc['constructor']` (Function constructor) to pass as truthy, enabling eval-equivalent code execution via `new Function(payload)()`
The new guard requires the method to exist as an OWN property of jsFunc AND be a function — constructor/toString/valueOf/etc. from the prototype chain are all blocked

files_modified.changes: Lines 137-140: replaced `if(this.jsFunc[methodName])` with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.jsFunc, methodName) && typeof (this.jsFunc as any)[methodName] === 'function'`. Changed bracket-notation call to `(this.jsFunc as any)[methodName](param)` to satisfy TypeScript after the IJSFunctionService interface typing.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: hasOwnProperty guard: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.jsFunc, methodName) ensures only explicitly declared own-property methods on the IJSFunctionService implementation can be dispatched. The prototype chain (Function constructor, toString, valueOf, __proto__, etc.) is completely inaccessible.
secondary_controls: VULN-019 fix (same file): sendKeys path now validates keyFunc against an ApplinX host key allowlist regex before dispatch
VULN-018 fix (pipeline): re-enabled artifact signing — tampered KeyboardMappings.json now detectable
VULN-014 fix (pipeline): npm ci with lock file — prevents supply chain injection of malicious KeyboardMappings.json via dependency confusion
Recommend: define an explicit Set<string> allowlist of permitted method names in IJSFunctionService implementations and cross-check methodName against it before dispatch
detection: Any future attempt to call prototype chain methods logs an error via the existing else branch
Add CI grep rule: flag any usage of bracket-notation dispatch on service objects without hasOwnProperty guard

validation_criteria: targetFunction='constructor(alert(1))' — methodName='constructor' blocked by hasOwnProperty check (constructor is NOT an own property of jsFunc)
targetFunction='toString()' — blocked (toString is prototype, not own property)
targetFunction='validMethod(param)' — passes only if 'validMethod' is an own property AND a function on jsFunc
Prototype chain hijack via VULN-002 attack path no longer produces code execution
